name: Adamas Trust Inc. 7.000% Series G Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock $0.01 par value per share
summary: Adamas Trust, Inc. operates within the United States, concentrating on the procurement, funding, investment, and ongoing management of residential properties linked to mortgage financing, encompassing both individual family dwellings and multi-unit complexes. The company's diverse investment portfolio includes various types of residential loans, such as those designated for business purposes, along with both government-sponsored and non-agency residential mortgage-backed securities (RMBS). Furthermore, it engages in structured investments in multi-family properties through preferred equity positions and mezzanine debt extended to property owners. Its holdings also comprise other strategic allocations connected to mortgages, housing, and credit, in addition to commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS). Beyond these financial instruments, Adamas Trust directly possesses and oversees single-family rental homes. For federal income tax purposes, the company qualifies as a Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT). This classification generally allows it to avoid federal corporate income taxes, provided it distributes a minimum of 90% of its taxable earnings to its shareholders. Established in 2003, the entity was previously known as New York Mortgage Trust, Inc. and is slated to officially adopt the name Adamas Trust, Inc. in September 2025. Its primary corporate offices are located in New York, New York.
